answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond to one hollow bore, filing its diameter, depth and serial at a vertex. An auditor recomputes wear from the bore table and checks the serial; a mismatch or reused serial burns the bond. The first pays 28 for inspection plus the 60 lock, 88 total; the kth pays 28+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6,022 and 1,000 fakes pay 3,025,000 plus 60,000 locked. Honest agents pay 88 once. A device farm that tries to forge one coupon for many bores fails, because a coupon binds one serial, one vertex and one wear reading, and reuse burns every linked bond.
